# Carcavelos Forecast – Wednesday, 1 July

**Light winds and consistent 1.8m NW swell make this a solid, mellow Wednesday.**

**MORNING (dawn–11:00):** Your window opens now. Waves holding 1.8m with minimal wind until 07:00—glassy and clean. Wind picks up slightly by 09:00, but stays light (under 12km/h). Water warming nicely from 19°C at dawn. **Best bet: 06:00–10:00** before the afternoon crowd arrives.

**AFTERNOON (12:00–19:00):** Swell eases fractionally to 1.5m as the day peaks at 29°C. Wind lightens to 6km/h around noon—buttery—then edges back to 16km/h by sunset. Still entirely rideable, just slightly messier.

**Tips:** Go soft-top or mid-length—the beachbreak will be forgiving. Hit the water early to avoid families. If you're after glass, commit to the 07:00–11:00 window; post-lunch is warmer but windier.
